observationsNotFindings: This is the most consequential document class I have reviewed in this sweep, because it proposes to add a required-now row rather than to measure a remainder, and the thing that makes it safe is the arithmetic being stated with its intermediate step intact. 26 to 27 to 28, with the 27 named inside limb 2 itself. A document that wrote 'cardinality 28' without naming the 27-member intermediate would read identically at a glance and would have concealed whether the G31 step was assumed or skipped.

The fallback clause is the strongest single sentence in the file. Rather than asserting that G31 will be recorded, it says what happens if it is not: the candidate is not recordable as G32 and a successor must retarget the identifier to the next unused number. That is a document declining to depend on an outcome it cannot control, and it also forecloses the failure mode where G32 is recorded at 27 because G31 quietly never landed.

Putting the G09 boundary inside the proposed claimCell — 'G09 owns permission truth, not this property' — rather than only in the disclaimer list means the refusal survives into the register row if the act is ever recorded. Disclaimers in a candidate evaporate on recording; cell text does not.

The subject states that dual independent ACCEPT 0/0 is a precondition for any later numbered recording. This verdict is one lane's, and every verdict pin the subject rests on is also Claude's, with no Codex counterpart anywhere in this chain. That standing is worth carrying to the coordinator explicitly, because unlike a leftover-join this candidate proposes to change the required-gate set.

The thirteen class definitions are long, prose-heavy strings full of tokens the dispatch forbids minting — FC-C1, CA-2, CA-1 IN_PROCESS. Quoting them verbatim is what makes the file look risky on a token scan and what makes it safe on inspection: every occurrence is inside a refusal that already existed in the accepted v8 contract, and the ordered == test confirms not one character was adjusted in the copying.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no should-fix. I enumerated the live register before opening the subject: file 08 carries 30 DR-G rows topping out at DR-G30, with no DR-G31 and no DR-G32, and condition 4 reads 26 of 26. The subject claims nothing to the contrary. The central quotation test passes exactly — namedThirteenClassesVerbatim is ordered-equal by == to live actor-join v8's thirteen-member joinFixtureClasses.classes, byte-for-byte and in order — and exactly thirteen distinct FC-JOIN tokens exist anywhere in the file, so no fourteenth class is smuggled in. The arithmetic keeps its intermediate step: 26 live, 27 if G31 is recorded, 28 for this act, with the 27-member set named inside limb 2 itself rather than only in a sibling field, so it is verifiable that the G31 step was not skipped. The strongest sentence in the document is its fallback: if G31 is not live at the recording act, this candidate is not recordable as G32 and a successor must retarget the identifier to the next unused number. That declines to depend on an outcome the document cannot control and forecloses recording G32 at 27. The G09 boundary is placed inside the proposed claimCell, not only in the disclaimer list, so it would survive into the register row. All eight FC-C1, nine CA-2 and seven CA-1 IN_PROCESS occurrences are quoted refusals, obligation references or denials — the only 'minted' in the file is 'is not minted here'. Twelve basedOn pins and thirteen recordedInputs all recompute, and all four cited verdicts are genuinely ACCEPT 0/0. One standing point for the coordinator: the subject requires dual independent ACCEPT 0/0 before any numbered recording, and this is one lane's — no Codex artifact exists anywhere in this chain. 21 attacks run, 21 refuted.
